versions.content: For each CanIfTxPduCfg that contains CanI- fTxPduXLParams where the parameters CanIfTxPduCanId and/or CanIfTxPdu- CanIdMask are configured or a MetaData item of type CAN_ID_32 is configured for the global PDU referenced via CanIfTxPduRef , the CanIfTxPduXLParams . CanI- fXLSduType shall be configured as 03h.
